_comment: Automatic betting rules (the Betting tab edits this). 'mode': 'off', 'paper' (bets are recorded, nothing is sent to Kalshi), 'demo' (orders go to Kalshi's test exchange, play money, KALSHI_DEMO_* keys) or 'live' (real-money orders, KALSHI_API_KEY*). A game gets a bet when the AI odds beat the ask on one side by at least 'min_edge' (0.05 = 5 points); each bet buys as many contracts as 'stake_usd' covers, and bets stop for the day once 'max_daily_usd' (cost + fees) is used up. Only sides priced between 'min_price' and 'max_price', with at least 'min_ais' AIs answering, in 'leagues', during the parts of the season in 'segments' ('preseason', 'regular', 'postseason'; season dates are on the Settings tab), are bet on.
